text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the meeting began, Daiichi Ruby let 
out a faint sigh.
choice_data_list: Shall we take a quick break?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“—If you are simply being considerate, it 
is unnecessary.”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I have taken every precaution so that no 
fatigue carries over into tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"If you judge that rest is necessary, 
please present a convincing rationale."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems Daiichi Ruby herself 
recognizes her fatigue. I should 
reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
